periodType.growth: Yeh ek genuinely strong period hai — real opportunities khul rahe hain, safe rehne ke bajaye inhe use karna better rahega.

periodType.grind: Yeh genuinely ek tough period hai — progress expect se slow hogi, par jo abhi carefully banaya jayega wahi tikega.
periodType.instability: Yeh period real unpredictability laata hai — purane patterns shayad na chalein, isliye fixed plan pe ade rehne ke bajaye flexible rahein.

timeEngine.noMajorTransit: Abhi aapki Moon rashi par Shani ya Guru ka koi bada effect nahi hai — yeh genuinely ek calm period hai, na extra pressure hai na extra opportunity. Steady rehne ka accha time hai.
